variant_notes: All six exact/released80 sample-prefix choices have identical selected text on all8 fixed anchors. This is local text agreement, not numerical equivalence or population agreement.
N1-parent pruning, coefficient pruning, zero-threshold pruning and most matched-deletion outputs are numerical-only here; missing judgments are not zero quality.
Random16/32 are same-pool experimental controls; matching admissibility in deployment may require retries.
The manual review uses the pinned transcript/stimulus and retained judge evidence, not external world-fact verification.

cost_scope.A: N samples plus their candidate bullet AR encodings and numeric fits; raw/cappedN1 need no reconstruction encoder.
cost_scope.C: Parent sampling/encoding and leave-one-out refits are recurring work; pruning from a cache does not make new-input inference free. No new helper calls or vectors for pruning itself.
cost_scope.D: Same recorded sample budget plus bullet encoding, fully refitted pooled search and bounded swaps; no runtime helper calls in this method.
cost_scope.missing: No per-case fresh latency or GPU-dollar cost inferred from the shared campaign. See source-bound cost evidence in031 and035.

limits: 38 numerical/output variants are available; only20 A/C/D/baseline/control variants have authoritative pilot judgments. Unjudged variants remain missing, not false or zero.
Eight shared anchors are illustrative, not representative; at most2 selected supplements per method group.
Full source context and retained evidence are evaluation-only; do not feed review feedback to selectors/helpers.
Method disagreement with retained judges is preserved in later reviewer annotations; official verdicts are never changed.
Primary human interpretation awaits independent review; supplements are selected examples, not rates.
